changes.title: Hat step skip
items: When there is no hat lying anywhere to put on, the morning pointer moves on to the next step instead of waiting.

changes.title: Treehouse crown seethrough
items: The treehouse oak's leaves now clear round the witch the way the forest's do: the see-through circle and her silhouette when she's under or behind them, and the canopy cut-away on the ground.

changes.title: Treehouse floor order
items: Treehouse room joins stay behind the witch while she walks or lands on them.

changes.title: Remove cloakroom hats
items: The old hats rug in the Cloakroom is gone: your hats now lie only on their spots in the Parlour.

changes.title: Leash chains to sigils
items: Your followers' chains hang from their sigils again, not from you: a follower walking to you drops its chain from its sigil to the ground, where it lies along the path it's walking.

changes.title: Kitchen texture resize
items: Kitchen artwork refreshes safely when its drawing size changes.

changes.title: Canopy hides berries
items: From the treetops, berries under the trees are hidden by the crowns: you see them only through gaps and round the witch.
